notes.title: STRAIGHT OUTTA EARLY ACCESS - BLUE EFFECT VR RELEASES ON OCULUS AND VIVE
notes.content:
Blue Effect VR is shooting its way out of early access to scare the pants off you on 9th February 2017.

Blue Effect is an atmospheric sci-fi wave shooter built and designed specifically for VR. Combining eerie atmosphere of the extraterrestrial world occupied with biomechanical horrors, Blue Effect will thrill you with excitement, test your endurance and try your bravery!

[b]KEY NEW FEATURES[/b]

[b]Railroad level [/b] - Experience a fast paced action on top of a moving train, while the aliens are hunting you down. No tickets needed, but prepare your trusty guns!
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26277682/974540bf6f1d733b3dda062bf0dff80264b058bf.png[/img]

[b]Raptor inbound [/b] - There is an angry alien lizard trying to catch the train. Do not let him by blasting him back to the ground!
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26277682/55db7d3f52530f9eef09b228168b059f87b071ba.jpg[/img]

[b]Hide & Seek in the Lab [/b] - It is time to face off against your buddy in our local PvP mode. Only this time you will have your trusty Orb to lighten the dark corners and spot the alien before it gets you!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26277682/88b772d270ddf8d197b907415a79111b2b42d527.jpg[/img]

[b]Summon a friendly Drone[/b] - According to your feedback, we have decided to add this option. Attacking player can from now on summon a friendly drone!


“Early Access lit the path to VR for us and help us understand what the community expects,” says Daniel Jerman, marketing manager at DiVR Labs. “We are aiming to use this experience to keep delivering top of the line products in years to come and we have our community to thank for that.”

[b]Feel the Fear![/b]

notes.title: Hide & Seek Christmas Update
notes.content:
Week 51 Lumos Update

Hello fellow diVRs! 

The Holiday Season is here, a time for many of you to take it slow and relax. Good for you! But we at DIVR Labs are not stopping! We are proud to announce a brand new game mode as part of the Hide & Seek Christmas Update. The eponymous PvP multiplayer mode is a thrilling experience which pits two players against each other in a local battle of wits and nerves.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26277682/393f6fed0f96c8312fd896784d85e52bc3a25dcf.png[/img]

Ready Player One

Put on the VR headset and stand your ground against waves of enemies and try to survive until the timer runs out. It might be only three minutes, but you will be sweating bullets by the end. The original experience of Blue Effect just got better with the introduction of a second player!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26277682/2c13d964c3e6c530819115728e631a76ee551f59.png[/img]

Ready Player Two

Grab a hold of a game controller of your choice and let the hunt begin! Your goal? Seek, scare and exterminate your friend in VR by taking control of one of the horrific monsters lurking in the darkened corners of the Blue Effect world. If you cannot take the pressure of the VR experience, you might give this one a try!

Hide & Seek game mode will no doubt determine who will end up on which part of the Santa’s Naughty or Nice List, but there is more to our Christmas Update. Hear us out!

The devs have been hard at work on fleshing out the dark future world of Blue Effect and we are proud to bring forth a new map called The Lab. Here you will be defending light pillars against waves of enemies, while having the luxury of using 2 weapons at the same time. Don’t let the pillars get destroyed, because once that happens, not even your extended arsenal will keep you safe…

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26277682/3e1c8a8c0d1d6a4e77c888fa62b57fb982b52449.jpg[/img]

The Lab as well as the older Warehouse level will grant you extra force by introducing various power ups, which will buff your ability to fend off the alien hordes. Unless you stumble on the wrong one, which will do the opposite… The naughty or nice concept yet again!

And to wrap this Christmas Update up, we are happy to lighten the mood by allowing you to wield a head of a snowman instead of the good old Orb. Don’t forget to turn this option on in the main menu!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26277682/9445edc5e5b4f5936e12689373cd4031d283bb01.png[/img]

Oh, did we mention Blue Effect is now 50% off during the Holiday Season on Steam? There is no better time to hop into the game than right now!

Thank you all for being the pioneers of VR gaming with us and for enjoying Blue Effect. There is more in store for you, our community of diVRs, in the upcoming year. Until then…

Have a great Christmas and happy New Year!

Your DIVR Labs.

notes.title: Community update - week 50
notes.content:
Week 50 Lumos Update 

Last week we brought you some photography from DIFF 16 that was an incredible event. Also, we have shown you our new environment called RailRoad. 

What you could learn is that this environment will be partly in the movement. There are many discussions about movement in VR and motion sickness. We firmly believe you don't need to be afraid in our game. There is no Motion Sickness. Even our CEO who has motion sickness even in the car does not suffer in RailRoad :)

But that's not all. A new enemy called Raptor will be part of this environment. You can check how does he look like here!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26277682/55db7d3f52530f9eef09b228168b059f87b071ba.jpg[/img]

Feel The Fear!

notes.title: Blue Effect - DIFF Dubai
notes.content:
Community update will have a short delay this week. Usually, I try to write it on Wednesday and have it ready for Thursday, but not this time. This week is exceptional for us here at DIVR. 
We have reached a great milestone in our existence. Organizers of Dubai DIFF (Dubai International Film Festival) have invited us to their kingdom, and we are very grateful for this opportunity. So Last day’s we have spent on the journey. Particularly the Airports, Hotels, great welcome parties and so on:)

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26277682/caadc52d93bca2b605af4f275c11f1b70fec2c79.jpg[/img]

But Mainly we are here to play with people our Blue Effect. According to one of the visitor named George - “This was one of the strongest VR experience I ever had.”

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26277682/24a1c8db0ad456680ad7141ff42d2f33d945717d.jpg[/img]

So what do we have here? We brought into Dubai a concept our of Mixed Reality. I have to say its awesome to watch people being scared, having fun and reveal all the emotions. With our game. Thanks belong to our Developer team. They made an incredible job.


We will be here in Dubai until 13th of December so if you are close to us, just stop by. We will be more than glad to see you here and chat about anything. By the way, while writing this article Samuel L. Jackson walked around our booth. Unfortunately, was not that fast to make a photo :(

And don't worry, we are still working on a new update. This week we should reveal more!

Cheers!

notes.title: Community update - week 48
notes.content:
Week 48 Lumos Update

Last week we promised you to reveal information about the new update. There we go! We will start with Lab Level environment. We will also show you some pictures from the development. Leave in the comment if you want to see more of these pictures.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26277682/1ff151861dd4b482f2635940a5dba693b33e325b.jpg[/img]

About Lab:
This week we will introduce you a new environment called “LAB.” This map has a little bit different game mechanics. We have realized that when you play a lot, the gameplay is the same, so we decided to change it a little bit. You can see four pillars in front of you. They are pretty shiny. The entire environment looks quite calm. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26277682/3e1c8a8c0d1d6a4e77c888fa62b57fb982b52449.jpg[/img]

Dynamic gameplay:
On the scale one to ten we wanted to reach a number fifty-seven, so we prepared the breathtaking show for you. Enemies will not have shiny eyes; you will barely see them. Pillars should bring a light. Once pillars go dark, only blue effect and yourself can help you. 
This change of gameplay should bring you even stronger and more immersive experience. When I played it, My heart rate was somewhere around 196.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26277682/30c015b653bf1c45916e515295f8738870a1ec23.jpg[/img]

Feel The Fear!

notes.title: Community update - week 47
notes.content:
Week 47 Lumos Update.

As you know, we are still under the heavy development of Blue Effect. We always wanted to have had a great game that will be scary, but also funny and content heavy. So what is going on in the studio and what are we cooking for you. 

Platforms Update:

1. Oculus Touch - We are working on it, and according to the last meeting, we should be able to be ready for the release date.
2. OSVR - We can promise that Blue Effect will reach out this platform very soon!


Content Update:

1. New environments:
We have been working on something special here. This is due to the fact we want to bring you a unique experience. 
- The first new environment is Lab Level. This environment is bound to mechanics of pillars. At first, you will see four shiny pillars and your goal will be to protect them. Once these pillars are destroyed, you will be shrouded in the darkness :)
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26277682/d136c7ab179c10a92128884769ee71231467b505.jpg[/img]
- Railroad Level is something totally different. You will fight from the MOVING train and also encounter a new enemy, called Raptor. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26277682/1cb3d3be20eaaa2e61527a921661a421097cfa6a.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26277682/4d8ac7041216d02669867fba1488764952ddbde3.jpg[/img]

In meanwhile you can check all our enemies on SketchFab:
https://sketchfab.com/divrlabs/models

2. Power - ups:
New mechanics of buffs or curse will be added into the game. Mystery box will randomly appear in our environments. You will be able to receive time-limited advantage or disadvantage for your session. We wish you the best of luck :)

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26277682/51e0ebd92b5efdcef3d3409deca03d04b63d15a5.png[/img]

3. PvP:
This feature will be the most crucial for you as gamers. We have been trying many prototypes (About that next week) and hopefully we found the right one. While testing we were sweating, yelling, maximized our heart rate and had so much fun. But about that later….

Thank you for reading and If you want to ask us about anything, just do it right here, right now.
